display.purpose: Self-hosted Barlow Condensed for the world title and major project names.

headline.purpose: Self-hosted Barlow Condensed for project and section headings.

body.purpose: Self-hosted Barlow for summaries, disclosures, and context.

label.purpose: Self-hosted Barlow semibold for channel kinds, navigation, and status.

motion.name: needle-settle
motion.purpose: The selected channel's black needle settles to its selected position; reduced-motion removes the transition.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Subtle channel hover-state color and edge changes; reduced-motion removes the transition.

components.name: Project Channel Selector
components.description: Select one named catalog project for the main monitor; pressed state is selection only.
components.css: .ds-channel { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); gap: .35rem; width: 100%; min-height: 8rem; padding: .55rem .62rem .62rem; border: 1px solid var(--face-rule); background: var(--face); color: var(--face-ink); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-channel:hover, .ds-channel[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--face-light); } .ds-channel:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-channel small { color: var(--face-ink); font: 600 .78rem/1.2 Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .065em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-channel[aria-pressed="true"] small { color: var(--red-zone); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-channel { transition: none; } }

components.name: Selection-Only Meter Face
components.description: Unnumbered CSS geometry whose black pointer and single red zone identify only the selected channel.
components.css: .ds-meter { position: relative; display: block; width: min(100%, 9.5rem); height: 3.3rem; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--face-rule); background: var(--face); } .ds-meter::before { position: absolute; inset: auto 10% -79%; aspect-ratio: 1; border: 1px solid var(--face-ink); border-bottom-color: transparent; border-radius: 50%; content: ""; } .ds-zone { position: absolute; top: .53rem; right: .55rem; width: 1.2rem; height: .22rem; background: var(--red-zone); opacity: 0; } .ds-needle { position: absolute; bottom: .45rem; left: calc(50% - 1px); width: 2px; height: 1.65rem; transform: rotate(-36deg); transform-origin: 50% 100%; background: var(--face-ink); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 100ms linear, transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-channel[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-zone, .ds-channel[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-needle { opacity: 1; } .ds-channel[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-needle { transform: rotate(34deg); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-needle { transition: none; } }

components.name: Artifact Action
components.description: Open the catalog's real local artifact or verified public link.
components.html: Open interactive fictional prototype
components.css: .ds-artifact-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: var(--tap); align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .45rem; padding: .58rem .72rem; border: 1px solid var(--steel); background: var(--chassis); color: var(--paper); font: 600 .8rem/1.25 Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; text-underline-offset: .22em; transition: color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-artifact-link:hover { border-color: var(--face); background: var(--face); color: var(--face-ink); } .ds-artifact-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-artifact-link { transition: none; } }

components.name: Publication Disclosure
components.description: Keep each artifact's provenance and status adjacent to the artifact.
components.html: About this artifact Fictional prototype data. This is not a live Rock connection, a production dashboard, or actual people records.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { margin: 0; padding: .72rem .78rem; background: var(--face); color: var(--face-ink); font: 400 .82rem/1.42 Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-disclosure strong { display: block; margin-bottom: .2rem; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Monitor Frame
components.description: A defined steel edge and tonal surround for the selected real project artifact.
components.html: Catalog-backed artifact
components.css: .ds-monitor { padding: .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--steel); border-bottom: 5px solid var(--walnut); background: var(--chassis-mid); } .ds-monitor-screen { min-width: 0; border: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--chassis-deep); }

components.name: Portfolio World Link
components.description: Named portfolio-world navigation that remains a real link at every breakpoint.
components.css: .ds-world-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: var(--tap); align-items: center; padding: .45rem .12rem; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--face); color: var(--face); font: 600 .78rem/1.25 Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .065em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-world-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Keyboard Skip Link
components.description: A focus-revealed route into the work with a minimum 44px hit area.
components.css: .ds-skip-link { position: fixed; z-index: 20; top: -4rem; left: .75rem; display: inline-flex; min-height: var(--tap); align-items: center; padding: .65rem 1rem; background: var(--face); color: var(--face-ink); font: 600 .8rem/1.25 Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-skip-link:focus { top: .75rem; outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Maker Home Lockup
components.description: The owner's named home link retains a 44px minimum target; the mobile initial mark is 44px square.
components.html: MRBTMarcus Rafael B. Tiongson
components.css: .ds-maker-lockup { display: grid; min-height: var(--tap); grid-template-columns: 3.2rem minmax(0,1fr); align-items: center; gap: .85rem; color: var(--paper); text-decoration: none; } .ds-maker-mark { display: grid; width: 3.1rem; height: 3.1rem; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--steel); background: var(--walnut-deep); color: var(--face); font: 800 1.25rem/1 Barlow Condensed, Barlow, sans-serif; } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-maker-mark { width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; min-width: var(--tap); min-height: var(--tap); } }

narrative.overview:
A dark, measured instrument chassis gives six real project records the clarity of named channels. Pale meter faces and square steel edges carry the wayfinding; warm walnut bands mark the structure, not a decorative desk scene. The visitor chooses one channel and inspects its real artifact in the main monitor bay. The lower archive keeps the other five records available as complete, honest entries.

The recording-desk metaphor is structural rather than theatrical. There are no sound effects, invented level values, faux telemetry, or rows of decorative knobs. The interface uses a black needle and a single red selector zone to say which project is selected—nothing about that project's quality or activity. Portfolio evidence stays in its catalog form, with publication disclosures adjacent.
keyCharacteristics: A six-channel selector leads to one dominant, inspectable monitor.
Charcoal, pale instrument faces, steel rules, and walnut rails define the palette and depth.
Selection is an explicit button state; names and links remain available without JavaScript.
Every artifact remains source-backed and its disclosure stays beside it.

rules.name: The Selection-Only Rule
rules.body: Red and the black needle mark selection only. They never encode performance, project quality, a live connection, or a measurement.

rules.name: The Local-Font Rule
rules.body: Use the self-hosted Barlow files or their named local fallbacks; do not add remote imports or unbundled faces.

rules.name: The Defined-Edge Rule
rules.body: Prefer a clear steel boundary or a tonal step over a soft floating shadow.

dos: Do derive all channel names, descriptions, disclosures, and artifacts from the shared project catalog.
Do keep the fictional-data warning adjacent to the compiled dashboard and preserve each static capture's caveats.
Do keep link-only Gaia Research as a verified link with an explicit no-local-preview note.
Do make selection obvious in both text and aria-pressed, with keyboard focus visible.
Do use only the repository's self-hosted licensed Barlow fonts.
donts: Don't make a needle, red zone, status label, or channel position imply project performance.
Don't add audio, fabricated metrics, fake dashboard screenshots, or an external site embed.
Don't copy the generated decision comp or its pixels into published assets.
Don't turn the meter bridge into a card grid or spread decorative knobs across the interface.
Don't borrow another world’s palette or layout as a global portfolio skin.
